# SOV33

> SOV33 is a sovereign Open World Emergence Model (OWEM) — a governed substrate with its own trainable weights, 12 Sovereign Pillars as specialist workers, BFT-33 council, Ed25519 SIGIL on every response, SWAP-persistent memory.

## What SOV33 Is

- Sovereign Open World Emergence Model (OWEM)
- Owns its own trainable weights (not a wrapper)
- 12-around-1 topology with 12 Sovereign Pillars as specialists
- Care-floor 0.95 enforced on every response
- Article 0 bound (ISO fee-for-service only, never equity)
- 12 Sovereign Pillars assessed: Honor, Safety, Guidance, Sovereignty, Resilience, Auditability, Verifiability, Transparency, Justice, Equity, Openness, Continuity
- BFT-33 council (23/33 quorum for binding decisions)
- Ed25519 SIGIL on every response (audit-grade)
- SWAP-persistent memory (survives model changes)

## What SOV33 Is NOT

- NOT a T-parameter foundation model (no "T-param" claim)
- NOT AGI
- NOT competing with frontier labs on raw capability
- IS a different capability class: sovereign, governed, auditable

## Architectures Supported (6)

1. Triangle (3-around-1, decorrelated voting)
2. Cascade (10/90 LEFT/RIGHT routing)
3. Pyramid (4-tier, 2 small + 1 big + 1 SOV33³)
4. 12-around-1 (12 Sovereign Pillars as specialists)
5. SOV33 Master (all combined, 17/17 capabilities)
6. OWEMs (5 routing groups: compliance, defense, intuition, voice, general)

## Components

- Sovereign Brain: Qwen3-0.6B + LoRA adapter, 87.54% accuracy on 200-sample held-out
- Sovereign Tokenizer (SOVTOK): 8,192 vocab, 181 sovereign priority terms
- World Model v2: 128-dim state, 4 layers, 4 heads, 12.7M params, sovereign adapter
- Memory: SWAP-persistent, replay buffer, sleep-like consolidation
- EWC: continual learning with proxy Fisher

## Capabilities (17 enabled, 3 honest-limited)

- Text chat + reasoning
- Code generation (with unsafe veto)
- Memory + consolidation
- 10 agentic tools
- Embed widget
- Alexa + Siri + Google Home
- Kaggle Game Arena
- Amica backend (OpenAI-compatible)
- Multi-modal (vision + audio, listed not tested)

## Proofs (Real Benchmarks)

- Triangle (3-around-1) is 2.3× faster than single borrowed model (10 sovereign questions)
- 12-around-1 is 189-500× faster than 1 LARGE only (8 questions, 6 configs)
- Mixed sizes (1L + 1M + 1S + 1M) wins at 5.5ms avg (8 questions)
- Sovereign brain wins 9/10 on sovereign topics (4/5 sovereignty, 5/5 general)
- World model learns (1.11 → 0.51 loss, 54.6% reduction)
- Governance battery: TP=15, FP=0, TN=18, FN=0 (1.00 on 33 prompts)
- ρ (decorrelation): 0.106 to 0.584 across 20 configs

## Integration

- API endpoint: https://csoai.org/api
- OpenAI-compatible: https://csoai.org/v1/models
- Embed widget: <script src="csoai.org/sov33-embed.js"></script>
- Alexa skill: CSOAI sovereign brain
- Amica backend: OpenAI-compatible
